metadata.title: Metagenome-assembled genome catalogue of Rub' al-Khali (Empty Quarter) desert soils
metadata.description:
Species-representative metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) from 551 shotgun metagenomes of Rub' al-Khali (Empty Quarter) desert soil, Saudi Arabia: 5,438 refined dRep representatives with CheckM2 quality estimates, MIMAG tiers, GUNC chimerism status, GTDB R232 taxonomy, Bakta and eggNOG-mapper gene annotations, a gene-level crosswalk of 20,451,986 predicted genes to annotations, and CoverM coverage profiles of all 551 libraries. The deposit also holds the specimen ledger, per-library laboratory batch and sequencing-run table, analysis-set membership, accepted soil pH measurements, and a tested worked example that follows one specimen to an annotated gene.

Reads, assemblies, bins and MAGs are deposited at ENA under PRJEB125153. See README.md for contents, methods, known issues and licence.

Portal: https://rubalkhali.science/
Code: https://github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/empty-quarter-ecology-data
